notes: PonziramidToken mints 1,000,000,000 PONZIRAM with 18 decimals once to msg.sender in its argument-free constructor. Transfers have no fees. The token has no owner, further minting, burning, pausing, or blocklisting. There are no application contracts. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
